title: Attach and fresh-attach dedupe
summary: Attach local and remote collections, deduplicate natural matches, and reuse the path only after confirmed replacement creation.
produces: Reference rewiring, epoch persistence, and after-merge report

conditions: Explicit tombstones and fresh-attach exclusions are honored.
Dedupe and reference rewiring preserve all intended data.
Repeated ambiguous ties continue to be reported.
Replacement attach cannot run before confirmation and successful POST.
W8 never initiates backup export or bypasses user consent.
